title: Great vacuum sealer, easy to use and saves food
text: Great vacuum sealer, easy to use and saves food. This is a great vacuum sealer machine. I use it every time I grocery shop at Sam's Club and buy a package of steaks, chops and or chicken. I seal portion sizes easily and flawlessly and am able to freeze foods without getting freezer burn on the meats. This was much easier to use than I thought it would be and if I can use this, anyone can. Great way, especially for single homeowners like myself to make meals and portions easily (also helps with keeping my caloric intake under control). Highly recommend to all.
